COLDWAR_IRQ_upgrade_baath_future = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_quoted }
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_pending_quote_gdp }
		}
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice min = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_quoted
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_enterprise_accounts_implemented }
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_citizenship_implemented }
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_social_bargain_implemented }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_pending
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_baath_future_instant_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_baath_future_instant_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_research_industry bonus = 0.25 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_baath_future_instant_0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}

				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_pending_quote_gdp }
		}
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice min = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_quoted

COLDWAR_IRQ_upgrade_oil_concession_delivery = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_quoted }
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_pending_quote_gdp
			}
		}
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_invoice min = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_oil_concession_delivery_building }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_quoted
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_renegotiate_implemented }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_active = yes
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_oil_concession_delivery_building
				171 = {
					is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
					free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
				}
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_pending
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_oil_concession_delivery_building }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_oil_concession_delivery_building_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				171 = {
					add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_oil_concession_delivery_building
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_oil_concession_delivery_instant_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_oil_concession_delivery_instant_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_research_industry bonus = 0.25 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_oil_concession_delivery_instant_0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_oil_concession_delivery_audit_upgrade_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}

			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_industry_heavy_building
				557 = {
					is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
					free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
				}
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_pending
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_industry_heavy_building }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_industry_heavy_building_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_industry_heavy_building_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				557 = {
					add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_industry_heavy_building
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_industry_heavy_instant_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_industry_heavy_instant_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_research_industry bonus = 0.35 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_industry_heavy_instant_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_steel_implemented
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_quote_upgrade_industry_heavy = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_quoted }
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_pending_quote_gdp }
		}
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0.05 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_implemented
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_invoice }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_steel_implemented
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_steel_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_steel_invoice }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_invoice min = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_industry_heavy_building }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_industry_heavy_audit_upgrade_quoted
	}

						var = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_society_mass_literacy_literacy_credit
						value = 0.025
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { LR_change = 0.035 }
				update_literacy_rate = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_society_mass_literacy_literacy_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { LR_change = 0.06 }
				update_literacy_rate = yes
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_society_mass_literacy_literacy
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_society_mass_literacy_audit_upgrade_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}

		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_audit_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = {
				COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_audit_pending_quote_gdp
			}
		}
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0.02 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_implemented
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_invoice }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_audit_upgrade_invoice min = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_staff_training_audit_upgrade_quoted
	}
}

			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_pending_quote_gdp }
		}
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0.02 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_implemented
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_invoice value = 0 compare = greater_than }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_invoice }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_invoice min = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_quoted
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_procurement_board_implemented }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_pending
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_defence_mixed_supply_instant_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_defence_mixed_supply_instant_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_research_aircraft bonus = 0.35 uses = 1 category = CAT_aircraft }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_defence_mixed_supply_instant_0
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_mixed_supply_audit_upgrade_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}

		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_defence_air_maintenance_audit_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
